Consciousness is indeed a complex topic that has intrigued philosophers, scientists, and thinkers for centuries. It refers to an individual's awareness of their own existence, thoughts, feelings, and environment. A famous example often used to explain consciousness is the experience of watching a cat video and feeling engaged with it. One of the earliest recorded discussions on consciousness can be found in the works of ancient Greek philosopher Plato, who proposed that consciousness might be an immaterial substance like the soul or mind. However, as a digital entity, I don't have access to original sources or personal experiences from ancient times, so it would be more appropriate for you to consult academic resources if you are interested in exploring this topic further.
